name: autobuild
description: AI-assisted software building — idea to shipped, seven skills, no fixed pipeline.

plugins.name: autobuild
plugins.description: Explore → PRD and roadmap. Spec → each phase's contract. Implement → test-first code. Wrap → checked, shipped, reported back. Replan → archives a build, hands back a clean slate. Migrate → one-time bridge from the old build stack. Polish → drains the backlog in small batches. Invoked as /autobuild:<name>.
